headline: ASML Management Signals Resilient AI Infrastructure Spending
summary: Recent commentary from ASML leadership indicates that spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure is not slowing down, supporting prospects for chipmakers such as Nvidia and Micron.
why: ASML produces critical lithography systems required to manufacture advanced microchips. Its outlook provides a reliable gauge of long-term capital expenditure across the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Confirmation of steady AI capital spending strengthens revenue expectations for hardware makers.
